$comment: Cloudflare Workers retained by the Sphere repository. The two Core Workers are Vite-built TanStack Start packages. Their code selects RAILS_ORIGIN_JP or RAILS_ORIGIN_US by request region, but no current Wrangler tier configures either value, so Rails-owned paths fail closed until the selected origin is configured. They declare no VPC binding. all/busy is a static maintenance Worker outside the pnpm workspace. tools/vpc-probe is a local diagnostic and is not a production deployment unit.
